content.rationale: S3-place fixes placement's mechanism — working-copy edits move into an older change via `jj squash --into <id>`, the working copy as source; M-layout places the module flat at src/jj_place.rs. It names the target and the paths to move — narrowing the source to that subset is the caller's, not this layer's — and crosses through the runner (M-jj), returning the crossing's outcome; which edit belongs in which change (roqpxulw's attribution) is decided elsewhere, and this layer interprets nothing.
